words: THE LEVER CATALOGUE (P7 sp8 row 3c, the remediation rail): every governed act the kernel itself can pull, DECLARED as data beside tools.v0.json and read by both kernels. A lever is what the kernel does with its own hands through the same doors a person would - a tool is what a body runs. The planner is shown the levers this door serves for the watch's metric and answers IN the catalogue; a routine lever runs at once under the intention's authority, a consequential one holds at the interlock for a person's click (the guide's law: the kernel never lowers the ladder because it is running on its own), a grave one is never pulled by the kernel. `for` names the watch metrics a lever can remedy ('*' = any; [] = declared, never offered as a remedy). `needs` names the arguments. `doors` names the kernels whose door serves it. `settles_s` is how long the kernel waits after pulling before it re-reads the watch.

levers.name: body.restart
levers.description: Restart a body this kernel seats that is PARKED (it died three times in five minutes, so the kernel stopped restarting it) or was refused at birth. Its deaths are forgotten and it comes back as the same self. A body that is alive or already restarting is left alone.

needs.name: the body's name, as the roster spells it

levers.name: service.check
levers.description: Probe one service on the shelf by name right now and record its health - the ladder steps to healthy or unhealthy. Nothing changes but the record.

needs.name: the service's name, as the shelf spells it

levers.name: mind.check
levers.description: Probe one mind (an LLM on the Stable) by name right now and record its health; a mind whose gateway entry went missing is written back from its ladder.

needs.name: the mind's name, as the Stable spells it

levers.name: service.restore
levers.description: Bring a retired service back onto the shelf - a new recorded fact, its retirement stays in the record. Only for a service the kernel or a keeper retired; never one a person rested on purpose.

levers.name: mind.restore
levers.description: Bring a retired mind back onto the Stable and into the gateway - a new recorded fact, its retirement stays in the record. Only for a mind the kernel or a keeper retired; never one a person rested on purpose.

levers.name: service.retire
levers.description: Rest a service or a mind that keeps failing - it leaves the shelf (a mind leaves the gateway too), recorded, never deleted; a person can restore it later. Consequential: it holds at the interlock for a person's yes.

levers.name: intent.stop
levers.description: Rest an intention - recorded, never deleted. Grave: a person's code, and a master's click for the kernel's own. The kernel never pulls it as a remedy.

levers.name: intent.restart
levers.description: Stand a rested intention again - a new recorded fact, its stop stays in the record. Grave, the same ladder as the stop. The kernel never pulls it as a remedy.

levers.name: mind.register
levers.description: Add a mind to the Stable with its deal (provider, model, price). Consequential; the keeper proposes it, a person cuts it.

levers.name: mind.assign
levers.description: Assign a body's class of work to a mind. Consequential.

levers.name: mind.unassign
levers.description: Take a body's class of work off its mind. Consequential.

levers.name: mind.refill
levers.description: Refill a body's fuel by an amount in dollars. Consequential.

levers.name: mind.repin
levers.description: Re-pin a mind's deal to the market's price. Consequential.

levers.name: world.rehome
levers.description: Re-home this universe to another cell - its epoch advances. Consequential; never a remedy for a red watch.

levers.name: join.admit
levers.description: Admit a body that proved its key at the join desk - a governing seat's yes. Consequential; never a remedy.

levers.name: level.open
levers.description: Open a floor under this universe, or a room on a floor - a level a crew can be seated on (Phase 8 sp1, THE PATH). Mode only tightens down the path (dev may hold prod; prod never holds dev); only a room opens as an experiment room. Consequential; a level stands forever once open; never a remedy.

needs.parent: the level it opens under (the universe, or a floor's path)
needs.name: lower-case letters, digits, - and _
needs.experiment: true for an experiment room (rooms only)

levers.name: craft.cut
levers.description: Cut a draft onto the shelf as a versioned craft - a template, prompt, skill, policy, graph, binding or golden set (Phase 8 sp2, THE SHELF WIDENED). The gate of the draft shelf: a registered craft at version 1, or the next version of one already there; the draft is spent. Consequential (L2); a resident's template asks the code (L3); firmware cuts only in a dev universe; an agent's template OPENS the Experiment (experiment.open). Never a remedy.

needs.person: its author - the seat that cuts

levers.name: experiment.open
levers.description: Open the Experiment on an agent's draft - the cut of an AGENT's template (Phase 8 sp4, THE EXPERIMENT AND THE CUT): an experiment room opens on a floor of the path, two arms run there (the standing version, and the candidate as a trial life), the grader and the critic write signed verdicts, the verdict is a proposal. Consequential (L2); never a remedy.

needs.draft_id: the agent template draft, the person's own
needs.person: its author - the seat that cuts

levers.name: experiment.promote
levers.description: Promote a proposed experiment's candidate - the human's stamped act: the sibling version lands on the shelf, the draft is spent, the agent's seat is written where its next life stands (floor and room are fields here), the body restarts into its next life. Consequential (L2 for an agent; a resident asks the code, L3); never a remedy.

needs.at: where the next life stands - a floor's or room's path (unsaid: where it stands now, else the universe)

levers.name: body.rest
levers.description: Rest a promoted agent - the ladder's first rung, the stop (rule 11): its life stops at a safe boundary, its self kept, its wear closed; restore brings a new life. Consequential (L2); never a remedy.

levers.name: body.decommission
levers.description: Decommission a RESTED agent - the grave: its live objects removed (the lease, the bench, the gateway key, the mind assignment; its schedules, watches and intentions rested; its wear links closed); its DID, its joins and its record kept; the components nobody wears any more are pruned by the beat. Grave (L3, the code); never a remedy.

levers.name: body.restore
levers.description: Restore a rested or decommissioned agent - a NEW life from the shelf's standing version of its template, on its seat; never a revival. Consequential (L2); never a remedy.
